correctness.rationale: Two separate full finite-field constructions using different irreducible polynomials enumerate the entire 532171-point plane and all 532171 lines. One joins curve-point pairs; the other tests every line, both computing identical line characters, four-secant counts, and 17-level external histogram. Each verifies the sharp min/max and the exact F_9 subplane maximum locus; incidence double counts match. Geometric smoothness follows from nonvanishing projective gradient in characteristic 3. All necessary code included.
